events.verdict: Williams (CHI) grasps Portis' (MIL) jersey and releases it as the ball is already being dislodged by White (CHI) during the rebound.
Rollins (MIL) is moving alongside LaVine's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Lillard (MIL) and Middleton (MIL) both make clean contact with the ball to begin the dislodge from White (CHI) before incidental arm contact occurs at the end of the drive.
Williams (CHI) gets his hand/forearm to the ball to dislodge it before incidental lower-body contact occurs with Middleton (MIL) during the steal.
Vucevic (CHI) firms over his left foot into Middleton's (MIL) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
LaVine (CHI) reaches for the ball when marginal contact occurs with Lillard (MIL) as he completes his intended pass.
Portis (MIL) commits a take foul on Giddey (CHI).
LaVine (CHI) legally closes out on Lopez's (MIL) jump shot to the side when incidental contact occurs with Lopez's slightly extended right leg.
Green (MIL) commits a take foul on LaVine (CHI).
